channel_invariant: every raw, projected, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted forbidden source is absent from every runtime channel
forbidden_runtime_sources: whole contributor input bytes or serialization
raw, normalized, projected, tokenized, length-derived, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted ISBN-10 or ISBN-13
raw, normalized, projected, tokenized, length-derived, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted local title
raw, serialized, path-derived, projected, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted private-query content
raw, projected, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted provider book or edition identity
raw, projected, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted registry, build, fixture, or qualification resource identity
raw request, response, header, transport address, database path, or fixture-resource identity
any stable correlation identifier or encoded substitute derived from a forbidden source
resource_identity_boundary: immutable public schema/build resource lengths and digests exist only in contributor-independent registry, build, review, and qualification evidence; runtime stdout, stderr, exceptions, logs, trace/span data, metric names/labels/values/exemplars, exports, reports, persistence, and audit records never contain them
runtime_channels: exception type, message, arguments, notes, cause, and context
trace and span names, attributes, and events
metric names, labels, values, and exemplars

title_only_metamorphic_contract.allowed_exported_change: identity-decision comparison may change only among equal, different, and not_compared; every other exported field remains governed solely by typed nonidentifying behavior
